fullDescription: Minimal center-aligned marketing navbar: a true-centered wordmark flanked by symmetric link groups on a sticky white-glass header, with one low-key ghost CTA. Black-on-white (ink #0a0a0b) + a single cobalt #2563eb accent, Inter, tight tracking, a rotating diamond logo mark, clean responsive reflow to a hamburger bar.

structured.summary: A minimal, center-aligned marketing navbar in the editorial/Vercel-Linear school: a true-centered wordmark flanked by symmetric link groups, on a sticky white-glass header with a single low-key ghost CTA. Black-on-white (ink #0a0a0b) with one cobalt #2563eb accent, Inter type, tight negative tracking, a tiny rotating diamond logo mark, and a clean three-column desktop grid that reflows to a hamburger + centered wordmark + compact CTA on mobile.

style.description: Restrained, premium editorial-tech aesthetic. Near-black ink on white, exactly one accent (cobalt blue), generous whitespace, no boxes or heavy shadows, only hairline borders. Inter with aggressively tight letter-spacing on the wordmark and headings. The personality comes from one signature detail (a small rotated cobalt square logo mark) and quiet hover transitions, not from color or chrome.
style.prompt: Use a minimal, high-end editorial/SaaS visual language on a pure white (#ffffff) background. Typeface: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700), antialiased, text-rendering optimizeLegibility. Apply tight negative tracking globally (-0.045em), tighter on the wordmark (-0.06em), and slightly positive on small nav links (+0.005em). Color system is monochrome + one accent: INK #0a0a0b is the primary text/foreground; use ink at reduced opacity for hierarchy (ink/70 for nav links, ink/55 for body copy, ink/40 for footer meta, ink/10 and ink/15 for hairline borders); the single accent is COBALT #2563eb, used only for the logo mark, one highlighted word, the primary filled button, and small eyebrow labels. No second hue, no gradients on the navbar, no drop shadows, only 1px hairline borders (border-ink/10). Buttons: a fully-rounded (pill) primary in solid cobalt with white text, and a fully-rounded ghost button = transparent with a border-ink/15 that turns cobalt on hover. Icons via Lucide/Iconify line set sized 14-22px. Everything communicates calm and precision rather than energy.

layout_and_structure.description: Sticky white-glass header (bg-white/85 + backdrop-blur-md, hairline bottom border). On desktop the nav is a 3-column CSS grid at 72px height: left link cluster justified-start, the wordmark perfectly centered via justify-self-center, and a right cluster (links + one ghost CTA) justified-end, so the brand sits at the TRUE optical center regardless of how many links each side has. On mobile/tablet it collapses to a single 60px flex row: hamburger left, absolutely-centered wordmark, compact CTA right. All inner content lives in a mx-auto max-w-7xl container with px-6 (lg:px-10) gutters shared with the page below.

prompts.prompt: Wrap the nav in a header that is sticky top-0 z-50 w-full, bg-white/85 with backdrop-blur-md and a 1px bottom border (border-ink/10). Inner nav is a mx-auto max-w-7xl container with px-6 lg:px-10 horizontal padding.

On lg and up render a CSS grid with grid-cols-3, items-center, height 72px. Column 1 (justify-self-start): a horizontal ul of left links. Column 2 (justify-self-center): the centered wordmark. Column 3 (justify-self-end): a flex row of right links + the ghost CTA. The grid is what guarantees the wordmark stays at the true center even though the link counts differ.

Column 1: a flex row, gap-9, of 3 nav links at 13.5px font-medium, color ink/70, hover -> full ink with a color transition (e.g. 'Gallery', 'Library', 'Canvas'). Give links a hair of positive tracking (+0.005em).

Column 2: a centered anchor (group, relative). The logo mark is a 10x10px square, rounded-[3px], filled cobalt #2563eb, rotated 45deg, placed absolutely to the LEFT of the text (right-full, mr-2.5, vertically centered) so the wordmark text itself sits at exact center; on group hover the mark rotates from 45deg to 135deg over 300ms. The wordmark text is 22px, font-semibold, ink, with extra-tight tracking (-0.06em).

prompts.partPt: Right link group + ghost Chamada Final para Ação
prompts.prompt: Column 3: a flex row, gap-9, justify-self-end: 2 more text links (same 13.5px ink/70 hover-ink style, e.g. 'Pricing', 'Docs'), then ONE ghost CTA = an anchor with a fully-rounded border (rounded-full), border-ink/15, px-4 py-[7px], 13.5px font-medium ink, that on hover turns border + text cobalt. Exactly one CTA, kept low-key (ghost, not filled) to match the minimalist tone.

Below lg, hide the grid and show a flex row, justify-between, items-center, height 60px: a hamburger icon button on the left (lucide:menu, 22px, ink/70), the wordmark+mark absolutely centered (left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2, 20px wordmark, same rotated cobalt mark but inline), and a compact ghost 'Start' CTA on the right (rounded-full, border-ink/15, px-3.5 py-[6px], 12.5px). Same cobalt-on-hover treatment. No horizontal overflow at 390px.

special_ui_components.prompt: True-centered wordmark via a 3-column CSS grid (justify-self start/center/end) so the brand is optically centered regardless of unequal left/right link counts
Rotated cobalt diamond logo mark (10px square, rounded-[3px], rotate-45) that spins 45deg -> 135deg on wordmark hover
Sticky white-glass header: bg-white/85 + backdrop-blur-md with a single hairline bottom border, no shadow
One low-key ghost pill CTA (transparent, border-ink/15) that adopts the cobalt accent only on hover, keeping the bar minimal
Opacity-based text hierarchy on a single ink color (ink/70 nav, ink/55 body, ink/40 meta) instead of multiple greys
Responsive reflow from a 72px desktop grid to a 60px mobile flex row (hamburger + centered wordmark + compact CTA) with no overflow

structured.special_notes: The defining move is the 3-column grid that pins the wordmark to true center, do NOT replace it with a simple flexbox space-between or the brand drifts off-center when the two link groups have different widths. Keep the palette strictly monochrome ink (#0a0a0b) + the single cobalt accent (#2563eb), express hierarchy through ink opacity rather than extra colours, and keep exactly ONE ghost CTA (resist adding a second filled button, the restraint is the point). Preserve the tight negative tracking (-0.045em base, -0.06em wordmark), the rotated-diamond mark with its hover spin, and the white-glass sticky header with only a hairline border. The hero/feature/footer sections below are optional page context, not part of the navbar pattern itself.
